data: What is the maximum y value of the dashdotted line in the left plot corresponding to the vertical axis on its left side?

The question asks for the maximum y-value of the dash-dotted line in the left plot corresponding to the vertical axis on its left side. From the caption, we know that the dash-dotted line represents 'No Change'. In the left plot, the y-axis is labeled as 'Percentage (%)', and the maximum value on this axis is 100%. Therefore, the maximum y-value of the dash-dotted line in the left plot is 100%.
